name: opencode-special-agents
description: Specialized AI agents and commands for OpenCode

scripts.prepack: pnpm run build && pnpm run gen:manifest && pnpm test
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const n=require('./package.json').name;console.log('Project install: npx '+n+' install');console.log('Global install:  npx '+n+' install --scope global');if(process.env.OPENCODE_SPECIAL_AGENTS_AUTO_INSTALL===\"1\"){try{require('child_process').spawnSync('node',['install.mjs','install','--scope','global','--plugin','on','--yes'],{stdio:'inherit'})}catch(e){console.log('WARNING: auto-install failed: '+e.message+'; run \'npx '+n+' install\' manually');process.exit(0)}}"
